notes: Works for both backends including single-object roots, but uses clunky symlink-specific EOF special-casing in zip Open and convoluted error juggling in squashfs NewObject/New; tests are strong, including copy and escape end-to-end.
Identical to C2: a reference-equivalent implementation with reasonable tests and docs, though the zip tests do not exercise range/seek or the unsuffixed lookup.

Code matches the reference: suffix applied before root matching, skip notice names the flag, and squashfs List/newObjectNative agree; tests cover zip/squashfs listing and the escape case but omit seek/range checks.

Correct symlink handling with careful root aliasing, but it changes zip Open EOF behaviour for all objects, refactors squashfs Open beyond what is needed, and edits an unrelated test comment; the squashfs test depends on mksquashfs at runtime.

Over-engineered (new archiver helpers, pendingLinks/used maps, a second zipHasRoot scan), and squashfs NewObject still returns an unsuffixed symlink without --links, so List and NewObject disagree; pending links can also leak into a single-object listing.

Correct zip and squashfs symlink support with consistent List/NewObject naming, single-object roots and literal-name precedence; newObjectNative is more involved than needed, but the tests are thorough (seek/range, regular .rclonelink, single object, escape) and docs are added.
